title: vegas captain mark stone signs 2 year 18m extension  flm 2026 09 12
text:
Sep 12 (Field Level Media) - The Vegas Golden Knights signed captain Mark Stone to a ​two-year, $18 million contract extension ‌on Saturday.
The deal with the 34-year-old forward and 2023 Stanley Cup ​winner runs through the 2028-29 ​campaign.
Stone matched his career high ⁠with 73 points (28 goals, ​45 assists) in 60 games last ​season.
He has 396 points (136 goals, 260 assists) in 400 games since joining ​Vegas in a Feb. ​25, 2019 trade with Ottawa.
Stone has 707 ‌career ⁠points (259 goals, 448 assists) in 766 games with the Senators and Golden Knights.
He has also ​posted ​97 points (48 ⁠goals, 49 assists) in 97 postseason games, ​including 24 points (11 goals, ​13 ⁠assists) during the Golden Knights' march to the 2023 Stanley ⁠Cup.
Ottawa ​selected the Winnipeg native ​in the sixth round (178th overall) of ​the 2010 NHL Draft.
--Field Level Media
